==Description==
'''CARDBOARD-5''' is a simple rusher that can only be spawned by admins.

==Behavior==
'''CARDBOARD-5''' will play the [https://create.roblox.com/store/asset/1846862303/Horror-Race?keyword=horror+race&pageNumber=1&pagePosition=0| Horror Race Song] and after a long time it will rush to the door

==Strategies& Tips==
Hide when you hear '''CARDBOARD-5's''' laugh

==Trivia==
'''CARDBOARD-5''' is just a redskined [[U-5]]
